# Milestone Development

Milestone Development is an Australian builder-led construction and property development company based in North Sydney, NSW. The team supports residential, commercial, industrial, renovation, design and construct, management services, and home and land package projects.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/): Construction services, project categories, process, team, and enquiry form.
- [About](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/about): Company approach, sectors, delivery model and contact details.
- [Services](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/services): Overview of seven core construction and management services.
- [Projects](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/projects): Clearly labelled concept imagery and supported project categories.
- [Construction Process](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/process): Consultation, planning, approvals, construction, quality control and handover.
- [Meet the Team](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/team): Mohammad Mohsini and Hussain Jafari.
- [Contact](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/contact): Project enquiry details and phone contact.
- [Privacy Policy](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/privacy): Data handling and protection disclosures under Australian privacy law.
- [Terms of Use](https://milestonedevelopment.com.au/terms): Website terms of use and project concept visualisations disclosures.
